_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.330 uses the standalone firmware runner for built-in GUI presets. The GUI verifies parameters and mode acknowledgements before one START; firmware owns all phases and breaks. Real product completion and fresh vented IDLE are required before marking a simulator row successful. Default retains its existing firmware and control profile.

The protected uploader now decodes the actual inflation/CVP flag order and restores supported scalar protocol settings with CRC and readback. Saved calibration and SysID values are preserved. Explicit firmware phase annotations keep inflation and inter-cycle waits out of deflation feedback; simulator direct starts retain verified preset settings in the recording manifest. Valinor retains its GUI label throughout repeated Max runs to prevent standalone presentation from switching system power off after the first trial.

Validation: Default four complete GUI START cycles, Arduino 20,631/20,631 (100%), NI 280,740 samples with no gaps/backtracks; 0-16 ms completion-to-deflation dispatch. Both branch layout audits and smoke tests pass; 126 Default/130 earlier Valinor focused checks plus 75 final CRC/phase checks. Ten-minute Valinor START measurements are retained in the delivery study. Matching runner execution is separate from accurate arterial MAP, pulse preservation, physical knob/button testing and fleet SysID qualification. No new controller tuning is released.

Final Valinor check: seven completed Max runs over 685.187 seconds, Arduino 20,129/20,129 (100%), NI 338,870 samples with zero gaps/backtracks. Valinor v3.2.131 also protects START/STOP with CRC and recognizes the actual DEF_PID deflation state. Final protected Default restoration is followed by the scored ten-minute seed-213 soak. Initial overspeed and Wrist undertracking remain measured limitations.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
